displayed_text:
Escalate the resident-money discrepancy directly to the organisation-level Safeguarding Lead as the first escalation contact; the worked example describes a staff member reporting to the registered manager who then escalates the concern the same day to the Safeguarding Lead as a financial concern.

The Finance Manager is not the initial escalation recipient but provides the financial-record and audit support once the Safeguarding Lead has taken the concern forward; site record-keeping applies only to the portion of funds the site actually holds on the resident’s behalf, and appointeeship-held funds and related transaction records are retained per the Records Retention Schedule (and reconciled/passed to executor or next of kin on death with the final transaction record retained).

Use the current safeguarding role terminology consistently: the card should show the organisation-level title 'Safeguarding Lead' for escalation (with site-level support from the 'Safeguarding Champion' where relevant), and follow the multi‑agency information‑sharing principle—share what is necessary and proportionate with the local authority safeguarding team and with the police where relevant.
